obfuscation_indicators: items not representative of ongoing operations
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and provides detailed segment, cost, debt, impairment, and asbestos-related information. Risk is elevated due to a significant net loss, declining segment operating profit, cost inflation, operational disruptions, restructuring charges, goodwill impairment, leverage-related financing activity, and substantial asbestos liabilities. Management frequently attributes results to adjusted or non-recurring items, which may complicate assessment of underlying performance.
